text:
Olivia: Quick thread — experiment plan for pricing & packaging page. Target: finalize tier names + prototype a usage calculator + update FAQ entries for Dedicated vs Hosted. Want final copy by EOD Wed. Thoughts?

Mike: Love it. For the calculator, growth recommends two modes: 'Estimate monthly cost' and 'Compare configurations' (hosted vs dedicated vs private). My proposal: surface the calc as a modal from the hero CTA and also as an inline accordion under pricing.

Priya: Agree on modes. A few engineering constraints: the calculator must allow inputs for avg tokens in/out, requests per minute, and model class. Also: we can't display Dedicated exact pricing until region and commit term are selected. Avoid implying SLA without explicit commit.

Sam: Design notes: proposing three naming sets to test:
- Option A: Developer / Team / Business
- Option B: Starter / Scale / Enterprise
- Option C: Pay-as-you-go / Reserved / Private
My preference is B — clearer for marketing but open to testing. I'll mock hero modal + inline accordion.

Cory: From sales: customers repeatedly ask what happens on reserved commit overage and how credits/rollovers work. FAQ must include: rollover policy, billing cadence, contact for enterprise negotiation, and a short blurb about data isolation for Dedicated/Private. Also add a clear line about what support SLA comes with each tier.

Jason: Engineering: we can expose a sandbox pricing endpoint for the demo. Example request payload for the calculator sandbox:```json
{ "deployment_type": "hosted", "qps": 10, "avg_input_tokens": 64, "avg_output_tokens": 128, "model_profile": "gpt-like-13b" }
```The response should return monthly_estimate, tokens_per_month, and model_cost_breakdown. We can seed the demo with three canonical workloads (chat, embeddings, rerank).

Mike: :thumbsup: I'll own the A/B experiment. Recommend test cells: Names: 'Starter/Scale/Enterprise' vs 'Developer/Team/Business' and headline variants 'Predictable inference pricing' vs 'Make inference costs predictable'. Target: 10k sessions per cell before evaluating.

Priya: Also request an 'Example bill' expandable section. Show a realistic monthly calc (e.g., 100k chat requests at avg 200 tokens in+out, + 1M embeddings at 768-dim) so non-technical buyers can grok the math.

Sam: Microcopy suggestions for calculator inputs: 'Avg tokens per request', 'Requests per minute', 'Model selection (e.g., small, medium, large)', 'Commit term (none / 1mo / 1yr)'. Will include inline help tooltips.

Olivia: Action items recap: Mike — A/B test setup and tracking; Sam — hero modal & inline accordion mock + microcopy; Priya — verify FAQ copy and example bill numbers; Jason — mock pricing API + seeded workloads; Cory — sales FAQ bullets + overage language. Review: Friday 9am sync.

deploy-bot: experiment created in Optimizely (OPT-12345) for pricing naming A/B test.

Olivia: Thanks everyone — if anyone has strong feelings on naming, drop your preference here. I'll consolidate names + content plan tomorrow morning.
